codeBlocks.code:
# Create .gitignore
cat > /home/user/Claude-/.gitignore << 'EOF'
# Dependencies
node_modules/

# Next.js
.next/
out/

# Runtime / generated
.claude-flow/daemon-state.json
.claude-flow/metrics/
.claude-flow/logs/

# Environment
.env
.env.local

# OS
.DS_Store
EOF

# Untrack daemon-state.json (it was previously committed)
git rm --cached .claude-flow/daemon-state.json

# Commit
git add .gitignore
git commit -m "Add .gitignore; untrack auto-generated .claude-flow runtime files"
git push
